## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2007-05-03: TRA executed at IPO close, 85% of Realized Tax Benefit to IBG Holdings LLC
- 2007-06-15: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the Q1 2007 10-Q

#### Ongoing operation (no amendments)

- 2007-2025: Annual 424B5 prospectus supplements register Class A shares for issuance on redemptions of IBG Holdings interests; each redemption produces an additional Section 754 basis step-up captured within the same TRA; no amendments, restatements, or terminations across 137 filings through May 2026

## Explanation

Interactive Brokers Group executed its Tax Receivable Agreement at the May 2007 Up-C IPO, committing to pay IBG Holdings LLC (the holding vehicle for the pre-IPO LLC members, principally Thomas Peterffy and affiliates) 85% of the cash tax savings on Section 754, 743(b), and 734(b) basis step-ups arising from the IPO Original Sale and subsequent Exchanges of IBG Holdings membership interests for IBKR Class A common stock. The contract has run unamended for nineteen years and has generated cumulative cash payments of approximately $308M through 2025, with an outstanding payable of $217M at year-end 2025. The 10-K continues to identify the May 2007 instrument as the operative agreement; the Exchange Agreement was amended twice in 2015, but those amendments did not modify the TRA itself. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
